mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI inflation rate above 0.5 percentage points signals rising inflation expectations that prompt the Fed to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, which typically precedes a consumer spending boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 50% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when GDPC1 grows, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 45% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending and housing market activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 50% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.3% signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when RSAFS rises > 0.3%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
